hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central Europe, northwest of Romania || mostly flat to rolling plains; hills and low mountains on the Slovakian border || landlocked; strategic location on main land routes between Western Europe and Balkan Peninsula, as well as between Ukraine and the Mediterranean basin; the Duna (Danube) and Tisza Rivers divide the country into three large regions || Resources: bauxite, coal, natural gas, fertile soils, arable land || Exports: cars, vehicle parts/accessories, electric batteries, packaged medicine, computers (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly flat to rolling plains; hills and low mountains on the Slovakian border || Central Europe, northwest of Romania

climate.excerpt: temperate; cold, cloudy, humid winters; warm summers

economy.excerpt: high-income EU and OECD economy; modest recovery from 2024 recession driven by private consumption and moderated inflation; challenges include high fiscal deficits, frozen access to EU funds, and risks from export reliance; implementing tax exemptions, price controls, and mortgage interest caps ahead of 2026 elections || Exports: cars, vehicle parts/accessories, electric batteries, packaged medicine, computers (2023) || Industries: mining, metallurgy, construction materials, processed foods, textiles, chemicals (especially pharmaceuticals), motor vehicles
